cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet rooftop citrus garden at a small modern cafe — she savours a freshly peeled orange wedge while proudly displaying the long unbroken spiral peel as a tiny trophy; the central atrium of a space station — carries her keepsake low at her side; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — holds a cup in both hands; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a bus shelter on a quiet street — holds a smartphone at chest height; the grand staircase of an old castle — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet lakeside paddleboat dock with a pink pedal boat tied beside the timber platform — she triumphantly lifts a tiny paper victory flag after winning a leisurely solo paddleboat time trial; a quiet spa lounge of robes — holds a book closed against her chest; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — kneeling on the ground; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — brings a cup to her lips; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — seated sideways on a stool or bench
